historical_references.reference: Sahinur was a famous Hindu general under the rule of the Vijayanagara Empire in the late 16th century. He played a significant role in the Battle of Talikota (1565) against the invading forces of the Deccan sultanate.
historical_references.context: Battle of Talikota against the Deccan sultanate

historical_references.reference: Sahinur was also known for his military prowess during the reign of Emperor Achyutadeva (r. 1542-1545) of the Vijayanagara Empire. He was appointed as the commander of the forces in the southern region and successfully repelled invasions from the Gangas of Orissa and the Keladi chieftains.
historical_references.context: Repelled invasions from the Gangas of Orissa and the Keladi chieftains
